speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have experienced fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, are you currently experiencing any pain specifically in your side or back?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms persisting despite improvement in your sinusitis are concerning. Have you noticed any changes in your urinary habits, such as increased frequency, urgency, or difficulty urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis likely caused by a beta-lactamase-producing organism (e.g., E. coli) leading to treatment failure with amoxicillin and cephalexin.
